title: Neurotic Manipulations
subtitle: Ductilis — the nerve of blood
text: The Neurotic tendency is the strangest — blood that has learned from precision, from the fine movements of craft and the slow patience of cultivation. Activation Potential (QUICK, 200): send a neural pulse that disrupts a target's coordination. Sanguine Ward (CONTINUOUS, 10/tick): shape your blood into a passive shield that absorbs incoming harm. Crimson Harvest (QUICK, 200): extend your reach into the blood of nearby organisms and draw resources — crops, materials, energies — toward you. The Ductilis practitioner does not attack. They redirect.
